title: Homemade Sub Buns
description: Soft, sturdy sandwich rolls perfect for loaded subs, hoagies, or heroes.

ingredients.item: Optional: grated cheese + Italian seasoning for topping

method.instruction: In a large bowl, combine lukewarm milk, sugar, and instant yeast. Let stand 5 minutes until foamy.
Add egg, oil, lukewarm water, and salt. Stir to combine.
Gradually add flour, starting with 440g. Mix until a soft dough forms. Add more flour if the dough is too sticky.
Knead for 8-10 minutes by hand (or 5-6 minutes in a stand mixer) until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1-1.5 hours until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide into portions: 8 rolls (≈120-130g each) for smaller subs, or 5 rolls (≈200-225g each) for large subs.
Shape each portion into an oval/torpedo shape by rolling it under your palms with firm, even pressure. Taper the ends slightly.
Place shaped rolls on a lined baking tray, leaving space between each. Cover and let rise 30-45 minutes until puffy.
Brush rolls with egg wash. If desired, sprinkle with grated cheese and Italian seasoning.
Bake for 12-15 minutes (small rolls) or 15-18 minutes (large rolls) until golden brown and hollow-sounding when tapped on the bottom.
Cool on a wire rack before slicing horizontally for sandwiches.

notes.title: Shape Matters
notes.content: For authentic sub shape, roll firmly with steady pressure to create an even cylinder. Tapered ends give that classic torpedo look.

notes.title: Toppings
notes.content: Try sesame seeds, poppy seeds, everything bagel seasoning, or garlic butter brushed on after baking.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Store in an airtight container for 2-3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months. Thaw and warm before using.
